name: dnd-soundboard
description: D&D Soundboard - play ambient sounds and music for tabletop RPG sessions

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "webpack --config webpack.main.config.js --watch" "webpack --config webpack.renderer.config.js --watch" "wait-on dist/main/index.js dist/renderer/index.html && electron . --inspect"
